Meeting: Redwood All-Hands (Feb 2025)

Transcript (auto-generated):
[00:00] Evelyn Hart: Morning everyone. Quick agenda, then we’ll do Q&A.
[05:12] Evelyn Hart: Monica’s going to cover a People Ops update.
[05:24] Monica Patel: Yep, thanks. So we’re doing a small benefits and perks refresh for 2025. This is not like a carrier change, it’s mostly improving the perks side.
[05:43] Monica Patel: Three things: wellness stipend is going up, we’re adding mental health sessions via the EAP, and parental leave is expanding starting March.
[06:08] Monica Patel: We sent an email and there’s a handbook page with the exact dates. The stipend and mental health start Feb 1, parental leave is March 1.
[07:15] Speaker 2: Is the stipend automatic or do we enroll again?
[07:21] Monica Patel: No re-enrollment. Same portal, same flow. Higher cap.
[08:02] Speaker 3: For parental leave, what if you’re currently planning?
[08:08] Naomi Feldman: Please email People Ops and we’ll confirm specifics.
[10:44] Evelyn Hart: Cool. We’ll link the page again in Slack.
